text:
Maria (partnerships): FYI we got a vendor notice: starting next month marketplace providers will start sending a key_id header separately and will change the key hashing algorithm from sha1->sha256 for UI+recon. This affects our dedupe + ledger mapping. Thoughts?

Kevin (finance): Important. If the hash changes, our existing ledgers that store only the hashed key might not match historical events. Do they provide a mapping (old_hash -> new_hash) during rollout? :warning:

Priya (partner-ops): Their note says they will emit both old_key_hash and new_key_hash for a 72h overlap during migration for each partner. They also promised a per-partner CSV with pairs.

Lina (eng): Good. We shouldn't rely on raw hash to identify partner. We should prefer explicit key_id header if present and fall back to legacy hash. Suggest update ingestion to: prefer header "X-Partner-Key-Id", then keyed mapping table that links key_id -> partner_id, and keep a rolling crosswalk for the 72h overlap.

Omar (eng-infra): Agree. Also recommend adding an idempotency key for events we insert into the ledger: `Idempotency: <partner_id>|<usage_window>|<event_hash>`. That reduces risk during replays when both hashes land.

Kevin (finance): How will late-arriving usage (e.g., events with timestamp older than ledger window) be handled? Our reconciliation assumes a 48h ingestion window. If they send dual hashes, we should still map to the original partner.

Maria (partnerships): We asked vendor about late-arrivals: they keep original partner_id in payload metadata and won't change partner assignment. So mapping should be stable. The problem is our pipelines that only store legacy_hash won't find matches.

Lina (eng): Plan: 1) Ingest path: if X-Partner-Key-Id present -> use it as canonical key, store both key_id and raw_hash. 2) If only legacy_hash present, consult crosswalk table to resolve to key_id. 3) During overlap, write both hash variants into ledger rows with a shared canonical id. 4) Add a reconciliation flag `hash_mapped=true/false`.

Omar (eng-infra): We'll need schema change (small) and a backfill job to add key_id for recent 90 days so reconciliation job continues to work. Also set dedupe-window to 30m -> 60m during the migration ramp to reduce false dedupe on replays.

Priya (partner-ops): For partner communications I'll request the CSV mapping and exact rollout schedule per region. Also ask them to include sample payload with both headers and sample late-arrival event.

marketplace-bot: NOTICE: Marketplace key-id header rollout planned 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z. Docs: https://marketplace.vendor/rollouts/3419991234

Kevin (finance): Action items for finance: 1) expect a short spike in unmatched events during overlap; plan a manual reconciliation run after migration window. 2) I'll add an extra nightly reconciliation that attempts to match using legacy crosswalk.

Lina (eng): Action items for eng: 1) Add key_id header parsing and crosswalk fallback (PR target: feature/key-id). 2) Schema migration to include `partner_key_id` and `hash_variant` columns. 3) Backfill job for 90d. 4) Increase dedupe window to 60m during migration.

Omar (eng-infra): I'll provision a small feature flag so we can rollout region-by-region. Also wire up a metric `ingest.unmatched_keys` and an alert if it exceeds 0.2% for 1h.

Priya (partner-ops): I'll coordinate CSV and sample payloads, and schedule a dry-run with the partner test environment a week before.

Maria (partnerships): Sounds good. Quick snippet for how to parse headers in the connector:```http
POST /usage
Headers:
  X-Partner-Key-Id: abc123
  X-Partner-Key-Hash: sha256:012345... or sha1:abcd...
Body: { usage: ... }
```

Lina (eng): Good example. We'll also hash incoming raw keys (if any) with both algorithms to populate the crosswalk. Avoid storing raw keys. We'll only record key_id and hashed tokens.

Kevin (finance): One ask: include the mapping CSV in the reconciliation job input so finance can run a dry-match. Ping me when the dry-run is scheduled.

Omar (eng-infra): Noted. Also we'll ensure logs redact full hashes except the first 6 chars: `partner_key_id=abc123, hash_preview=sha256:012345..`

Maria (partnerships): I'll post vendor timeline and the CSV when I get it. Thanks team. :pray:

Lina (eng): I'll open the PR today and tag owners.

Kevin (finance): :thumbsup:
